segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You scramble over the edge of the basket, tumbling onto the fleece floorboards right next to the giant shivering bulldog.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: I can't!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan wailed, his big black-spotted jowls flapping as he buried his face in his paws.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: My paws are like jelly! The wind is windy! The dark is dark! My emotional constitution is compromised!

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: Titan, they're shooting nets at us!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: you yell, pointing over the side.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: I need emotional support!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan bellowed softly.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Pip! Did you bring them?! Tell me you remembered the emergency ration!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip froze. His eyes went wide. He patted his empty pockets in frantic despair.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: The nubbies!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip shrieked.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: I left the bacon-and-cheddar nubbies on my tea desk!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan let out a devastating, heartbroken whimper that could have melted an iceberg.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: THWACK!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A silver tinsel net snapped onto the bottom of the wicker basket, dragging the balloon downward toward the roof!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You look at your winter jacket. When you escaped your house in Arizona this morning, your mom had put a small plastic baggie in your pocket for your family's puppy: crunchy, star-shaped holiday dog biscuits.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You rip open your pocket.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: Titan!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: you shout, holding up a golden, crunchy star-shaped biscuit right in front of his big black nose.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: LOOK!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan’s droopy eyes snapped open. His nostrils flared like two jet engines.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: SNIIIIIIIIFFFF.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Is that...

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan whispered, his little docked tail giving a sudden, hopeful twitch.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: ...an artisanal, oven-baked poultry-and-herb nubbie?

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: It’s Thanksgiving turkey flavor,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: you say.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: And the whole bag is yours—plus as many ear scratches as you want—if you get us into the sky right now!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Scratches?!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan gasped, his eyes shining like Christmas morning.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Ear scratches AND nubbies?!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan’s posture changed in half a second.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: His eyes locked onto the burner handle. With a ferocious, thunderous snort of pure determination, the giant American Bulldog rose on his hind legs, seized the brass burner throttle with both paws, and yanked it all the way down!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: ROOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAR!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A twin pillar of brilliant blue-and-gold flame blasted into the peppermint balloon!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The tinsel nets snapped like thread! The basket surged straight up into the snowy sky, leaving the shouting Nutcrackers and their flashing searchlights shrinking into tiny dots on the snowy ground below!
